app.title: Download the app
app.lead: One app for every Boffmedia pack: install, update and launch Minecraft with the mods already set up, plus the Boffmedia tools built in. No copying folders by hand.
app.loadFailedLead: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps failing, let us know on Discord.
app.emptyLead: We're preparing the first public release. Check back soon.
app.smartscreenTitle: Windows will warn you about an «unknown publisher»
app.smartscreenLead: Boffmedia App isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen shows a warning the first time you install it: click «More info», then «Run anyway». You can confirm the file is ours with the hash below.
app.verifyLead: Our server computes these hashes from the exact bytes we publish. If your file's hash matches, it is the same file.

requirements.webview: WebView2, already included in Windows 10 1803+ and Windows 11.
requirements.ram: 8 GB RAM for small packs; 16 GB recommended for large ones.
requirements.account: A Minecraft: Java Edition account (you sign in with Microsoft).

delta.title: Incremental updates
delta.lead: When three mods change you download three mods, not the whole pack.

mods.title: Your mods survive
mods.lead: A separate folder for your own additions: the minimap you add isn't wiped by the next update.

versions.title: History and rollback
versions.lead: If an update breaks the pack, one click puts you back on the previous version.

auth.title: Signed in as you
auth.lead: Microsoft sign-in, and private packs only visible to the people with access.

java.title: Java and memory handled
java.lead: Installs the Java each pack needs and tunes memory per instance.

crash.title: Crashes in plain language
crash.lead: Reads the crash report and tells you what happened: a missing dependency, out of memory…

packPage.installLead: This pack installs from the Boffmedia App. Download it, sign in, and it appears in your library.
packPage.optionalLead: What you can switch on or off when you install it, and change at any time afterwards.

appAuth.title: Authorize the app
appAuth.lead: Enter the code Boffmedia App is showing you.
appAuth.loginLead: Sign in to authorize an app on this account.
appAuth.codeHint: Case and the dash are ignored.
appAuth.notFound: That code is not valid or has expired.
appAuth.confirmLead: This app will be able to see and install the packs your account is entitled to. It will not be able to change your account.
appAuth.approvedLead: You can go back to the app — it will sign in on its own within a few seconds.
appAuth.deniedLead: That app was not authorized. Nothing was shared with it.
appAuth.alreadyApprovedLead: This code was already approved. The app has signed in — nothing more to do here.
appAuth.alreadyDeniedLead: This code was already rejected. Start again from the app if you meant to authorize it.
